run_source.title: Run Source
run_source.description: Optional identifier for the seed source.

snapshot_date.title: Snapshot Date
snapshot_date.description: Date string used for output rows, for example 2026-04-29.

webhook_url.title: Base44 Webhook URL
webhook_url.description: Optional webhook URL. If provided, actor will POST { items: [...] } after crawl.

webhook_headers.title: Webhook Headers
webhook_headers.description: Optional headers for webhook POST, for example auth tokens.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Recommended for Shopee. Use Apify Proxy or residential proxy if Shopee returns empty pages.

items.title: Seed Items
items.description: List of Shopee product links to crawl.

sku.title: SKU
sku.description: Internal SKU or parent SKU used to group crawled variants.

product_link.title: Product Link
product_link.description: Shopee product detail URL to crawl.

product_name.title: Product Name
product_name.description: Optional product name used as fallback metadata.
